events.title: Steam Next Fest is here!
events.summary: CHARM! RISK! EXTRACT! Explore Okima, charm Amiko, and decide how far you dare to go while risking your loot. The Amiko Legends demo is available now, for a limited time. Tell us what you think! Your feedback shapes the game and your experience. You can use the Steam Hub or our Discord server: https://discord.com/invite/F2NU4CYFUc If you're having fun, please wishlist the game. Thanks for being here, and see you in Okima!

events.title: Amiko Legends Demo - Q&A
events.summary: When will the game be released? We’re aiming to release Amiko Legends in Early Access by the end of 2026. How much will Amiko Legends cost? Amiko Legends will be a one-time-purchase premium game on Steam. Pricing remains to be determined.What platforms are you planning to release Amiko Legends on eventually? events.title: The Amiko Legends Closed Beta is closed.
events.summary: As per our previous News, the Closed Beta of Amiko Legends is now closed. Thank you for all your feedback and bug reports, this truly makes a difference, and we can't wait to see you jump back in. Make sure to wishlist the game if you haven't yet, and enjoy the summer. Touch grass, play games, and see you soon with a better Amiko Legends!

events.title: Closed Beta players: Thank you!
events.summary: Closed Beta players: thank you The Closed Beta on Steam will close on July 21st, and we wanted to take a moment before anything else: thank you.You were the first players to step into Okima outside the team, and provided a lot of valuable feedback. That matters a lot! On the bug reportsA special thank you to everyone who took the time to report issues. events.title: How to kickstart your Amiko Legends adventure? A gameplay introduction.
events.summary: Hello everyone, First we want to thank you for the enthusiasm surrounding the launch of the Closed Beta! It's awesome to see so many players joining and enjoying the game. Please keep the feedback coming, here or in Discord. If you need some help to get you started, have a look at that 20 minutes gameplay video! Discover the world of Okima, and enjoy a few tips to improve your chances of success.

events.title: Welcome to the Amiko Legends Beta!
events.summary: First of all, thank you for joining us.Today marks an important milestone for the team as we open the doors to the first Beta of Amiko Legends.This Beta is an opportunity for us to validate core gameplay systems, gather your feedback, and continue shaping the future of the game together. While there's still plenty of work ahead, we're excited to finally put the game in your hands.Please note: Amiko Legends remains in active development.
